topic: Is Mueller Pro Chopper Worth It?
angle: Does Mueller Pro Chopper live up to the hype — and who should actually buy it?

reviews.title: Mueller Pro Chopper
pros: 8 interchangeable blades (dice, grate, slice, wedge) with a built-in storage tray that keeps everything in the base
Large 1.5-quart capacity container — actually chops a full onion or three eggs at once, not just a single serving
Stainless steel blades that stay sharp through months of weekly use; the included cleaning brush actually reaches the corners
